# SQL Notebook Kit 0.1.0 alpha

This is an API-unstable alpha: advertised Python APIs and notebook behavior may change
before 1.0. Breaking alpha changes will be identified in the changelog and release
notes, and serialized notebook metadata remains explicitly versioned and migrated.

Supported runtimes are CPython 3.11–3.14, JupyterLab 4, and VS Code 1.100.0 or newer
with Microsoft Jupyter. Browser-only `vscode.dev` is unsupported. DuckDB is the only
certified backend. Amazon Redshift, Databricks SQL, and Google BigQuery are preview
backends pending live credential-backed suites; custom synchronous DBAPI factories are
best effort.

The Python wheel includes the JupyterLab prebuilt extension and a VS Code companion
installed with `sql-notebook-kit vscode install`. The VSIX is also attached as a
convenience asset but is not published separately to the VS Code Marketplace.

Known limitations include API instability, preview-only cloud backend status, manual
VS Code/accessibility release matrices, and no browser-only VS Code support. See the
[full changelog](https://github.com/cesar-alves/sql-notebook-kit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md),
[compatibility contract](https://cesar-alves.github.io/sql-notebook-kit/0.1.0/compatibility/),
and [versioned documentation](https://cesar-alves.github.io/sql-notebook-kit/0.1.0/).
